sources.title: Jezero surface texture
sources.summary: A HiRISE color detail of Jezero terrain from observation ESP_039348_1985, acquired December 18, 2014. The original map-projected product has a 25 cm/pixel scale; the bundled wallpaper is a resized visual crop.
sources.limitations: The wallpaper crop has no verified geographic transform. Its pixels, route markers, local scale and simulated hazard overlays must not be interpreted as georeferenced observations. Do not apply the original 25 cm/pixel scale to this resized crop.
sources.usage: Public domain; credit requested by HiRISE.

sources.title: Jezero mineral context
sources.summary: PIA23239 combines spectral information with orbital imagery. NASA reports clays and carbonates in delta sediments, evidence of past alteration by water.
sources.limitations: Published false-color composite, not a raw spectral cube or a calibrated mineral abundance map. It covers a different footprint from the HiRISE crop. Colors do not establish a mineral identity for an arbitrary selected pixel.
sources.usage: NASA/JPL scientific imagery; retain full credit, no endorsement implied.

sources.title: A rover's view of the delta
sources.summary: PIA24485 shows a delta remnant viewed from the landing site on February 22, 2021. NASA describes the remnant as about 2.3 km west of the rover; colors approximate human vision.
sources.limitations: An archived viewpoint, not a live camera or the view from a selected simulation waypoint. Published colors are an estimate of natural appearance.
sources.usage: NASA scientific imagery; retain full credit, no endorsement implied.

sources.title: Measured regional elevation
sources.mission: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter / Mars Global Surveyor reference
sources.summary: USGS's Jezero CTX elevation mosaic uses stereo imagery at 20 m/pixel and is tied vertically to Mars MOLA. A compact 96 by 80 nearest-neighbor subset provides measured regional height context offline.
sources.limitations: Regional 20 m source data cannot resolve individual rocks or astronaut footing. The decimated subset has nominal 58.75 by 59.5 m spacing; no pixel registration with the separate HiRISE wallpaper is claimed. Preview colors have no bundled quantitative legend.
sources.usage: USGS public-domain data; credit the source institutions.

sources.title: Registered Jezero CTX orthoimage
sources.summary: Georeferenced orbital imagery resampled into the exact projected extent of the measured DEM subset. PDS4 product urn:nasa:pds:mars2020_ctx_basemap_2021:data:m20_ctxortho_mosaic, version 1.0.
sources.limitations: Registration follows the source transforms, not an independent survey. About 6 m output pixels do not resolve astronaut footing. Transparent pixels are NoData. The separately bundled HiRISE wallpaper remains unregistered.
sources.usage: USGS public-domain scientific product; preserve institutional credit.

sources.title: Regional geological framework
sources.credit: Vivian Z. Sun and Kathryn M. Stack, USGS, 2020
sources.summary: USGS Scientific Investigations Map 3464 relates Jezero's geological units to the surrounding Nili Planum region. DOI: 10.3133/sim3464.
sources.limitations: Reference link and bibliographic context only. This app does not ingest or reproduce the publication's geological-unit polygons.

sources.title: NASA Mars Trek
sources.summary: An external portal for exploring Mars mission data and comparing larger-scale terrain context.
sources.limitations: External reference only; requires internet. The app does not claim a live Mars Trek connection.

sources.title: Perseverance raw image archive
sources.summary: Official image archive for further inspection of the rover's observations.
sources.limitations: External reference only; requires internet. Bundled imagery is a fixed archive snapshot, not a live feed.

sources.title: CHITRA Marswalk scenario
sources.summary: The demonstration terrain grid, habitat, waypoints, hazards, oxygen budget, exposure, timing and science scores are authored scenario inputs or calculations.
sources.limitations: Not NASA measurements, a validated spacesuit model, a radiation forecast or an operational navigation system. Computed route results inherit all assumptions of the scenario.
